boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Grinnell College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Grinnell destinations with directly documented availability until at least 9 p.m.; verify academic-break and holiday schedules before leaving.

cards.title: Campus Café Until 10:30
cards.subtitle: Joe Rosenfield ’25 Center • academic-year evenings
cards.notes: Walk to the JRC for a late snack, then check Dining Services before visiting during breaks because the Grill follows altered schedules.
cards.short_summary: The campus café provides the board’s latest regular on-campus closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College states that Spencer Grill is open until 10:30 p.m. every day during the academic year and accepts cash, dining dollars, and campus cash.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours are 7:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m. Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–10:30 p.m. Saturday, and 9 a.m.–10:30 p.m. Sunday; break hours vary.

cards.title: Dinner Service Until 10
cards.subtitle: Joe Rosenfield ’25 Center • Sunday–Thursday
cards.notes: Use the Sunday-through-Thursday dinner window for a later campus meal, and consult posted break schedules before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A four-hour evening service window keeps the main dining hall operating late on class nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College lists regular Marketplace dinner service from 5–10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 5–9 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Regular dinner hours end at 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9 p.m. Friday–Saturday; commencement and break schedules differ.

cards.title: An 11 P.M. Supply Run
cards.subtitle: 415 Industrial Avenue • daily essentials
cards.notes: Head here for groceries or forgotten supplies before 11 p.m.; confirm holiday changes on the store page before a special-date run.
cards.short_summary: The latest everyday retail option in this set covers food, toiletries, and school supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart’s official page identifies Grinnell Supercenter #647 at 415 Industrial Avenue and lists store hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Walmart Supercenter in Grinnell, IA | Store 647
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the main store as open Monday–Sunday from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; individual departments have separate hours.

cards.title: Midnight on Friday and Saturday
cards.subtitle: 1020 West Street • counter-service food
cards.notes: Save this West Street stop for the latest weekend food window, while noting that Sunday closes earlier than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: Weekend service reaches midnight, with 11 p.m. closings on most weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco John’s official Grinnell page lists closing at midnight Friday and Saturday, 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Friday–Saturday, 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, and 10 p.m. Sunday according to the official location page.

cards.title: Pizza Through 10 P.M.
cards.subtitle: 613 West Street South • daily closing
cards.notes: Order or visit before the 10 p.m. store closing; arrive earlier if you want the evening buffet, which ends before the restaurant does.
cards.short_summary: Daily operating hours offer a predictable late pizza option south of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Ranch’s official Grinnell location page lists the restaurant as open from 9 a.m.–10 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Pizza Ranch in Grinnell, IA | 613 West Street S
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant hours are 9 a.m.–10 p.m. daily; the listed evening buffet ends at 9 p.m.

cards.title: An 11 P.M. Weekend Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: 1019 West Street • Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday carryout window for the latest closing; review the service tabs because dine-in hours end earlier.
cards.short_summary: Delivery and carryout extend one hour later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Grinnell page lists delivery and carryout until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut: Pizza & Wings - 1019 West Street
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout close at 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; listed dine-in hours are earlier.

cards.title: Sandwiches Until 9
cards.subtitle: 812 Sixth Avenue • daily service
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order before 9 p.m.; use the official location page rather than assuming later chain hours apply here.
cards.short_summary: This downtown sandwich counter maintains the same evening cutoff throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s official page for Grinnell Store 2103 lists restaurant and delivery service ending at 9 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Grinnell | Jimmy John's 2103
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are 10:30 a.m.–9 p.m. daily; delivery is listed from 11 a.m.–9 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Groceries Until 9
cards.subtitle: 320 West Street South • daily store hours
cards.notes: Use the main store for an evening grocery run, but shop earlier for prepared-food counters and the pharmacy because departments close sooner.
cards.short_summary: The supermarket fills the practical nine-o’clock slot for groceries and household basics.
cards.evidence_claim: Hy-Vee’s official Grinnell store page lists the supermarket as open daily from 7 a.m.–9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The main store is open daily from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.; pharmacy, kitchen, bakery, pickup, and delivery hours differ.

cards.title: Friday Dinner Until 11
cards.subtitle: 1014 Third Avenue • restaurant seating
cards.notes: Choose Friday for the 11 p.m. closing, or arrive before 10 p.m. on most other nights; Sunday has the earliest cutoff.
cards.short_summary: The downtown restaurant provides the set’s latest non-chain Friday dining window.
cards.evidence_claim: El Cascabel’s official site lists hours until 11 p.m. Friday, 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Saturday, and 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Closes at 11 p.m. Friday, 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Saturday, and 9 p.m. Sunday according to the official site.

cards.title: A 10 P.M. Weekend Oven
cards.subtitle: 816 Fifth Avenue • Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday order before the 10 p.m. close; Sunday through Thursday service ends one hour earlier.
cards.short_summary: A locally operated pizza dining room extends its schedule on weekend evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Pagliai’s Grinnell’s official website lists hours of 5–10 p.m. Friday and Saturday and 5–9 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; the official site lists a 5 p.m. opening each day.
